headline: Nikon disqualifies AI-generated winner of Small World in Motion contest
summary: Nikon disqualified the winning entry in its Small World in Motion contest after ruling it was generated using AI, and is now re-evaluating its contest rules. Outlets differ on whether the disqualified entry was an image or a video; The Verge says it originally came from Dr. Ning Xu and purported to show cilia in a child's airway.
